verdict.rationale: Gitea's first-party docs state it tracks requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues, and it advertises managing work via kanban boards alongside labels and issue tasks. Issues add planning attributes such as milestones, assignments, due dates, time tracking, and dependencies. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of board/column behavior (creating boards, moving cards, column configuration), independent or hands-on corroboration of the kanban feature.
